description: This file defines a Fragment subclass named FragmentTabsFragment that manages a tabbed interface using a custom TabManager class. It sets up tabs linked to other fragments and handles their lifecycle within an Android application.

classes.name: FragmentTabsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that manages a tabbed interface with multiple child fragments.

classes.name: TabManager
classes.description: A helper class that manages tabs within a TabHost, associating each tab with a fragment. Implements tab change handling and state restoration.

classes.name: TabInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates information about each tab, including its tag, associated fragment class, arguments, and fragment instance.

classes.name: DummyTabFactory
classes.description: A simple TabContentFactory that creates a dummy view for tabs, since actual content is managed via fragments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the TabManager and sets it up with the activity and fragment manager.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, sets up the TabHost via TabManager, and adds tabs linked to various fragments.

methods.name: onViewStateRestored
methods.description: Restores the tab state after configuration changes.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current tab state for restoration.
